def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    import copy; out=[r[:] for r in g]
    # pattern = nonzero cells in row 0 (or top rows) contiguous segment
    r0=next(r for r in range(h) if any(g[r]))
    cols=[c for c in range(w) if g[r0][c]]
    # anchors: nonzero cells elsewhere
    anchors={}
    for r in range(r0+1,h):
        for c in range(w):
            if g[r][c]: anchors[g[r][c]]=(r,c)
    for c in cols:
        col=g[r0][c]
        # vertical down
        end = anchors[col][0] if col in anchors else h-1
        for r in range(r0+1,end+1): out[r][c]=col
        # horizontal from anchor to pattern col
        if col in anchors:
            ar,ac=anchors[col]
            for cc in range(min(ac,c),max(ac,c)+1): out[ar][cc]=col
    return out
